text:
Besides the latency issue there is one thing that is often overlooked:

FG has a considerable amount of overhead. This overhead scales with the number of pixels per second.

So what does this mean:
.) If you are running FG on a 4090 at 4K with Ultra details and max RT this is no big deal because a 4090 is fast enough to handle that overhead up to 120fps.
.) If you are running a game in 1080p with Ultra details and max RT on a 4060 it also works pretty well because you have only 1/4 of the pixels.
.) But if you are running something like 4K DLSS balanced RT off and Medium details this will not work well as the overhead of generating a frame with FG is not much faster then calculating a native frame.

A good example for this is Diablo IV where the game is so leighweight that FG does not improve framerate at all.
